title: Erasmus Mundus Master's in Multiphase Systems for Sustainable Engineering
about: The two-year Erasmus Mundus Master's in Multiphase Systems for Sustainable Engineering, run by Mines Saint-Etienne, Politecnico di Torino and TU Munich, takes applications for its 2027 campaign from 2 November 2026 to 31 January 2027 (11:59 PM Paris time).
card_alt: Card for the Erasmus Mundus Master's in Multiphase Systems for Sustainable Engineering from the MULTIPHASE Erasmus Mundus Joint Master; apply by 31 Jan 2027. The photo is a generic city skyline over a river at sunset, not a programme location.
